job.job_description:
HIRING FOR ONE OF THE TOP REPUTED MNC'S!




Job Title: AI/ML Engineer
Experience: 6-9 Years
Job Location: Bangalore /Hyderabad/Chennai
Employment Type: Full-time
Education: Any UG/PG (Full-time)
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred




Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate AI/ML Engineer with strong expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation(RAG), MLOps, and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and optimizing scalable AI/ML applications and intelligent systems.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI/ML solutions using modern machine learning techniques and frameworks.
Build and optimize LLM-based applications and RAG pipelines.
Develop scalable ML models and deploy them in production environments.
Implement MLOps best practices including CI/CD, model monitoring, versioning, and automation.
Work with structured and unstructured datasets for model training and evaluation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven business solutions.
Fine-tune and optimize transformer-based models for various use cases.
Ensure performance, scalability, and reliability of ML systems.



Required Skills

Strong experience in AI/ML Engineering
Hands-on expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs)/ Vertex Ai /Gemini/ADK
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Strong knowledge of MLOps/GCP
Proficiency in Python
Experience with TensorFlow
Good understanding of model deployment and cloud-based ML workflows
Experience with vector databases and prompt engineering is a plus



Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Generative AI applications
Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
